title: 36 Hours in Istanbul
abstract: With architecture from the Roman, Byzantine and Ottoman periods as a backdrop, Istanbul is now the rare place where readers of Archaeology and Wallpaper magazines can clink glasses with equal zeal.

title: 36 Hours in Istanbul
abstract: A weekend in a city best described as venerable and youthful, holy and avant-garde.

title: 36 Hours in St. Petersburg, Russia
abstract: The former Russian capital has recaptured much of its glamour and offers an enchanting landscape not only for lovers of culture but for their children as well.

title: 36 Hours in Baltimore
abstract: A harbor makeover, Colonial history and emerging art galleries give the city reasons for out-of-towners to visit.

title: 36 Hours in Baltimore
abstract: Sometimes the forgotten middle child among Eastern cities like Washington and New York, Baltimore is all grown up. It’s still a big city with a small-town feel.

title: 36 Hours in Moscow
abstract: A weekend in a metropolitan city that has maintained its brash and flashy side.

title: 36 Hours in Moscow
abstract: Few places in the world have undergone such a rapid, dizzying and cacophonic transformation as Moscow, and it shows no sign of abating.
